question: Which of the following is NOT a type of chromosome, on the basis of the location of the centromere?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lophocentric**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Chromosomes are grouped into 4 categories based on the position of the centromere.
 
• Metacentric: 
 
 
• When the centromere is located at mid of the chromosome.
